yoke.column.name: Yoke (roll / pitch)
yoke.column.note: centre plate of the handle (roll / pitch come from the yoke base)

unplaced.yoke.button.1: generic catalog button; several buttons on the handle and no numbering source to say which is 1

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), yoke handle seen from the pilot's side and above: two horns, centre plate with the Virpil logo, controls on the left horn's hub and a hat on the right horn
mappingSource: catalog (product page https://virpil-controls.eu/p-jet-yoke-handle.html); no numbering sheet exists, the catalog has only a roll/pitch part and one generic button without input
note: the photo shows more controls than the catalog lists: on the left hub a hat or rotary (0.36 0.31), a ribbed wheel (0.44 0.34), a red button (0.41 0.39) and a grey button (0.43 0.42); on the right horn a hat (0.65 0.31). The catalog's single "Yoke button 1" cannot be tied to any of them.
